title: AuthenticatorType
description: An Authenticator type's declarative manifest: how tools authenticate to a kind of Target. It names the secret slots a Credential fills with Secrets (each written by the Runner as a file or set as a variable), the non-secret params, the tools it needs, how a check and the capability report's usage name the material, the check that proves the identity, and the query that proves what it may do. Nothing acquires, refreshes, or revokes: the material comes with the Job. Twigs provide them; nothing is built in.

version.description: Incremented on every change a Credential's params or checks could notice.

interactive.description: The type needs a human (device code, browser SSO); a Job cannot use it, and the Nest refuses a Credential of it for Jobs.

secrets.description: The slots a Credential fills with Secrets of its Environment, by name.

env.description: Non-secret variables set for the Credential's checks and for the work, as templates of {params.x} (AWS_DEFAULT_REGION from params.region). A template whose parameter is absent sets nothing.

params.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) for the Credential's params. Never secret.

git.description: Git over HTTPS with the Credential: the Runner sets git's credential helper for https://<host> in the work's git configuration, answering username and the value of the variable password_env names, so git clone and fetch work and the token is never on a command line.

host.description: The host (and port), a template of {params.x}.

requires_tools.description: Binaries the checks and the tools need on the Runner image's PATH; may use {params.x}. A missing one is an error on the check, named, not a failed Job.

requires_network.description: Hosts the tools reach, with {params.x} placeholders: what the operator's network policy must allow. Declarative; nothing enforces it.

usage.description: How to use the Credential, for the capability report's how-to-use column and the agent's brief, as a template of {params.x} and {credential.name}. Never secret.

guide.description: How an agent works with a Credential of this type, in Markdown, for its brief: the tool's forms that use it, worked examples, and the pitfalls (how to pass a script, what not to retry). A template of {params.x} and {credential.name}. Never secret. The Runner adds on its own what the Credential sets (each variable and file, by name) and, for a write Credential, how ops act runs a command, so the guide does not repeat them.

permissions_hint.description: What to grant and which Secrets to fill, for the UI and MCP (every type ships it).

AuthenticatorPreflight.title: AuthenticatorPreflight
AuthenticatorPreflight.description: The checks: authn proves the identity (its expect.json value is the report's identity); authz is the type's own allow check, run before the Credential's authz_checks; authz_query is the provider's authorization query every Credential authz check must be.

AuthzQuery.title: AuthzQuery
AuthzQuery.description: The provider's authorization query (a can-i style query). Every Credential authz check of this type must start with prefix (placeholders as in run) and may pass after it only the flags listed (a flag's value after = or as the next word), so a check cannot run another command with the material or send it elsewhere. The Nest refuses others at save and the Runner refuses them again.

flags.description: Flags allowed after the prefix; each takes a value when it ends with =.

AuthenticatorVariants.title: AuthenticatorVariants
AuthenticatorVariants.description: Per-value overrides chosen by one param (ambient's tool: aws, gcloud, az, vault). The param must be an enum in params with a default or be required; the chosen value's fields replace the manifest's.

AuthenticatorTypeName.title: AuthenticatorTypeName
AuthenticatorTypeName.description: Name of an Authenticator type, <provider>.<name>, or one word for a type no provider owns (ambient). Which names exist is data, the types installed Twigs provide, not an enumeration.

Check.title: Check
Check.description: A command the Runner runs as a child process, without a shell, and what counts as passing. The command line is split into words first, then each word's placeholders ({params.x}, {secrets.<slot>}, {credential.name}, and the Hop kind's {hop.*}) are rendered, so a value never adds a word; a run that is exactly one {params.x} placeholder is that parameter split into words (a user-supplied check such as http.api_key's). With no expect, exit code 0 passes.

CheckExpect.title: CheckExpect
CheckExpect.description: Expected result of a Check (expect: {json: $.Arn, contains: ...}). Every given condition must hold.

json.description: A JSONPath into the command's standard output, which must parse as JSON.

contains.description: A substring of the standard output, or of the value at json when json is given.

Duration.title: Duration
Duration.description: A relative duration: a non-negative integer and one unit (ms, s, m, h), such as 60s, 15m, or 1h. Absolute deadlines use RFC 3339 timestamps instead. Compound forms such as 1h30m are not accepted.

ParamsSchema.title: ParamsSchema
ParamsSchema.description: A JSON Schema (2020-12) for an object of parameters, as a Hop kind or Authenticator type manifest declares it. The Nest validates params with it.

SecretSlotName.title: SecretSlotName
SecretSlotName.description: Name of a secret slot an Authenticator type or Hop kind declares (kubeconfig, key, authkey); a Credential or Hop maps each slot to a Secret.

SlotDefinition.title: SlotDefinition
SlotDefinition.description: One secret slot of an Authenticator type or Hop kind. as file: the Runner writes the value to <work>/secrets/<owner id>/<path> (mode 0600; path defaults to the slot's name), {secrets.<slot>} is that path, and env, when given, is set to the path (or its directory, with env_dir); as env: the value is set as the variable env, and has no placeholder. env may use {params.x}. join: when several Credentials of a Job set the same variable, their values are joined with it (KUBECONFIG ':'); without join the Nest refuses the Job. optional: a Credential may leave the slot unfilled.

env.description: The variable, a template of {params.x}; required for as env.

path.description: as file: the file's path under the owner's directory, relative and clean (config.json, docker/config.json).

env_dir.description: as file: env is the file's directory, not the file (DOCKER_CONFIG).

join.description: The separator several Credentials' values of the same variable are joined with.
